setup.locked: A match against the AI is in progress, so the setup is locked. Finish it or give up in the vs AI tab.
setup.playersHint: Tap the colors that are playing.
setup.tilesHint: Copy the layout from the official app or setup card. ⟲ marks a tile that is upside down.
setup.structuresHint: Drag a structure onto its hex, or tap it and then the hex. Drag on the board to move one.
setup.confirmNew: Start a new game? This clears the board and all markers.
setup.exportHint: This is the same format the command-line tool reads.
setup.importHint: Paste a game file (as exported, or written for the command-line tool).

problem.players: Choose at least 3 colors (Cryptid needs 3–5 players).
problem.tiles: Each of the 6 map tiles must be used once.

me.spectatorHint: As a spectator you know no clue: the board shows what can be deduced from the markers alone. Pick your color to enter your clue and get advice.
me.clueHint: Used only on this device, to work out what you know that others don't.
me.locked: In a match against the AI your seat and clue are dealt to you: see the vs AI tab.
me.useplay: Switch to Play to place discs and cubes.

play.hintsOff: Solver hints are off during a match. Turn them on in the vs AI tab.
play.error: {{error}}. Check the last marker you entered.
play.markersOnly: from the markers alone — set your clue in Me to narrow it down
play.noWorld: No cryptid location fits these markers and clues. Check the last marker you entered.
play.onOneOf_one: The cryptid is on one of {{count}} hex ({{view}}).
play.onOneOf_other: The cryptid is on one of {{count}} hexes ({{view}}).
play.tapHint_one: Tap a hex to place; tap again to remove. {{count}} marker on the board.
play.tapHint_other: Tap a hex to place; tap again to remove. {{count}} markers on the board.
play.highlight: Highlight possible hexes (thicker outline = likelier)
play.inMatch: During a match, moves are made in the vs AI tab.
play.cubed: Replaced the cube {{player}} had there; a hex holds only one cube.

advice.spectator: You are a spectator: pick your color and clue in the Me tab to get advice.
advice.needClue: Set your clue in the Me tab first: advice depends on what only you know.
advice.usePlay: Use Play to place markers; here you can place your recommended cube.
advice.settingsHint: Moves are scored as value × chance of winning + what you learn − λ × what others learn. Defaults (λ 0.5, win 16 bits) won most often in AI-vs-AI self-play.
advice.penalty: A "no" costs you a cube: here is where to put it.
advice.searchWhy: {{p}} chance the cryptid is there; if not, expected to teach you {{gain}} bits and give others {{leak}}. Place your disc, then each player answers in turn; record their answers in Play.
advice.askWhy: {{p}} chance of a disc. Expected to teach you {{gain}} bits and give others {{leak}}.
advice.status_one: Cryptid is on one of {{count}} hex from your view ({{bits}} bits of uncertainty).
advice.status_other: Cryptid is on one of {{count}} hexes from your view ({{bits}} bits of uncertainty).
advice.noCube: Nowhere legal to place a cube.
advice.cubeHint: Hexes your clue rules out, least revealing first. Bits = how much the cube would tell the other players.
advice.worst: Worst option: {{hex}} at {{bits}} bits. Tap a numbered hex to place there.

col.winTip: Chance this move wins the game
col.gainTip: Bits you learn (if it doesn't win)

match.intro: Play a full game against AI opponents on a random board. Your clue is dealt to you; the AIs see only their own.

levelHint.normal: asks good questions, searches only when certain
levelHint.hard: the strongest policy found in self-play

match.othersRandom: The AIs get the other colors at random.
match.threeBasic: Three-player basic games are often decided on the first turn.
match.replaces: This replaces the game in the other tabs.
match.hints: Solver hints (highlighting and the Advice tab)
match.cubeHint: Tap a hex your clue rules out. The Advice tab can suggest the least revealing spot.
match.keys: Keys: <kbd>A</kbd> ask · <kbd>S</kbd> search · a color's letter picks whom · arrows + <kbd>Enter</kbd> choose the hex
match.askWhom: Ask whom? Then tap a hex.
match.searchHint: Tap a hex your clue allows. If everyone else places a disc, you win.
match.confirmGiveUp: Give up and reveal everyone's clue?
match.cubed: That hex has a cube: no one may use it.
match.cubeAllowed: Your clue allows that hex. Cubes go where your clue rules the cryptid out.
match.searchNotAllowed: You can only search a hex your clue allows.

log.title: Log (newest first)
log.searchFails: {{p}} places a cube: the search fails.
log.win: {{p}} found the cryptid on {{hex}} and wins!

validate.intro: Place the markers, then check a set of clues without seeing them. Each player enters their clue in turn and passes the phone on. A clue is never shown again: to verify it, enter it once more.
validate.enterHint: Choose your clue, then tap Save. It won't be shown again.
validate.verifyHint: Choose the clue again to verify it. A wrong choice sounds a buzzer.
validate.consistent: The clues entered fit the board and the markers.
validate.consistentNone: No clues entered yet. The markers alone leave a possible world.
validate.contradiction: The clues contradict the board or the markers.
validate.title: Clue validator
validate.useMarkers: Switch to the Markers tab to place discs and cubes.

keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keys.tabs: Setup, Me, Play, Advice, vs AI
keys.enter: Act on the cursor's hex (like tapping it)
keys.matchEnter: Ask about, search, or cube the cursor's hex
